coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies in units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance. This includes most units in pre-1980 multifamily properties, new construction (Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980), single-family homes, rooming houses, most condominiums and government-subsidized units. Exempt unit types are not covered: Golden Duplex, units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath, certain ADU-property tenancies, university housing and nonprofit cooperatives.

result.notes: requires_unknown_facts is set to false: the rule covers ordinary rental buildings (pre-1980 multifamily, new construction, single-family homes, condos). Its exemptions are listed in unverifiable_exemptions instead. owner_occupied_exemption_max_units is set to null because the owner-occupancy exemptions are not a simple owner-occupied unit-count threshold: Golden Duplex also requires owner occupancy on 12/31/1979, and the ADU and shared-facility exemptions have tenancy-timing conditions. Setting it to 2 would wrongly exempt all owner-occupied duplexes. owner_conditions is cleared as redundant with unverifiable_exemptions. The Civ. Code § 1950.5 reference is removed from the summary because no document cites that section. No construction cutoff applies, since both pre- and post-1980 units are covered.
